faq_heading: West Vancouver schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 19 schools with a West Vancouver street address: 16 public schools and 3 independent schools. In that list, 3 schools marked as offering French Immersion and 1 alternate program.
Public schools here are run by School District 45 (West Vancouver). Count by district: School District 45 (West Vancouver): 16.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
Public secondary schools with a West Vancouver address: Rockridge Secondary, Sentinel Secondary, West Vancouver Inglewood Secondary and West Vancouver Secondary.
The Ministry file marks these West Vancouver schools as offering French Immersion: Sentinel Secondary, École Cedardale and École Pauline Johnson Elementary.
Independent schools listed for West Vancouver include Collingwood School, Mulgrave School and St. Anthony's.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
The West Vancouver school district publishes its catchments only as an interactive map, not as a list of streets. Use the district's own page to check an address:

faq.q: How many schools are in West Vancouver, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 19 schools with a West Vancouver street address: 16 public schools and 3 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers West Vancouver?
faq.a: Public schools with a West Vancouver address are run by School District 45 (West Vancouver).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a West Vancouver address?
faq.a: Ask School District 45 (West Vancouver) to confirm it for the exact street address.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
